shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
circular/disc motif (rosette on B, concentric circles on A)
justification: Both are relief-carved surfaces showing human figures and round disc/rosette motifs organised in horizontal zones, but that is about as generic as such correspondences get. A is a single frontal, massively schematic anthropomorphic block-figure with abstract circles and incised markings, while B is a naturalistic narrative frieze of profile figures in procession, a horse-drawn chariot, rosette borders and a stepped crenellated parapet — different subject matter and utterly different rendering conventions.
